# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon widens sharply (>2% of ATR), indicating increasing momentum, a break above the prior bar’s high on strong volume (>1.5× 20-period average volume) offers a low-risk long entry. Enter at the close of the breakout bar.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon width = (9-EMA – 50-EMA) / ATR(14). When ribbon width > 0.02 and the current bar’s high exceeds the previous bar’s high, and volume > 1.5× the 20‑period average volume, enter long at the close of the bar. Exit: stop at the low of the breakout bar (chart-stop); TP1 at 1× ATR; runner trailed by a 20‑percentage‑point chandelier exit (i.e., trail = 20% of the high-water mark below the high). Regime: effective in VIX 15-25 and after 10:20 ET (45 min after open); avoid VIX <12 where ribbon width signals noise.
